name: UserFine Speed Engine
author: sandeepgupta737

sections.description:
UserFine Speed Engine is a professional-grade speed enhancement tool by Sandeep Gupta. It helps WordPress websites achieve faster load times and pass Google Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID, CLS) automatically.

Main Features:
* Auto WebP: Converts heavy JPG/PNG into modern WebP format.
* Smart JS Defer: Prevents JavaScript from blocking site rendering.
* Native Lazy Load: Only loads images when needed to improve CLS score.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire userfine-speed-engine folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Access settings via Settings > UserFine Speed.
sections.faq:
Does it support Elementor?

Yes, it is fully compatible with Elementor and other popular page builders.
